name: spotter-push-models-to-hub
description: CONN-10: export spotter.ml.form_quality@champion (ONNX) and publish it with the manifest and model card to the Hugging Face Hub. Run after retraining the form model (CONN-04). Runs with --skip-pose: importing Ultralytics' OpenCV crashes serverless compute (SIGABRT), so the pose models (Core ML + ONNX) are published from a Mac with `uv run --group publish push_to_hub.py --skip-form`, which also runs the Core ML models before upload. Replace <workspace-folder> with the folder holding push_to_hub.py and export.py; the HF token comes from the secret spotter/hf_write_token.
